title: Opera Neon now supports MCP Connector that let you control the browser through other AI clients
partialText: Opera Neon enables MCP Connector enabling external AI clients to connect directly to the browser, access live web context and act inside it.

title: Opera wins four 2026 iF Design Awards for Opera Neon, Opera Air, Opera GX, and Opera GX Mobile
partialText: Hey all, Today we’re announcing that Opera has won four 2026 iF Design Awards, doubling last year’s tally. Opera Neon, Opera Air, and Opera GX Mobile won in the Branding and Communication Design category, while Opera GX was recognized for its User Interface.
